baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two occurrences of ء م ن at words 2 and 5 flank purposeful action and the reception of what was sent down; the ayah then moves through covering wrongs to repairing bāl.
baseline_models.mechanism: Heart-settling trust makes intentional action possible, renewed assent receives delivered truth as a stable reference, and the resulting Lordly response is both subtractive and constructive: harms are covered and the inner self is repaired.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling security supplies the trust that opens and then steadies the action-reception sequence.
Assent in which the heart rests makes the second belief a renewed reception rather than empty repetition.
Purposeful doing makes deeds the enacted middle of the sequence.
Delivery from above supplies the received object that retunes prior trust and action.
Stable correspondence with reality gives the delivered message its orienting reference.
Covering that makes offenses as though unperformed supplies the subtractive repair.
The opposite of corruption links righteous output to the later act of restoring the person.
The self, heart, and field of concern identify the interior that is constructively repaired.

changed_reading.before: The ayah lists belief, good deeds, and belief in revelation before promising forgiveness and peace of mind.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages an iterative circuit: trust enables action, delivered truth renews and orients trust, then past damage is covered and the acting self is repaired.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same root ص ل ح occurs first in the believers' deeds at word 4 and then in God's action upon their bāl at word 17.
baseline_models.mechanism: Repair travels in both directions across the ayah. People enact what resists corruption; their Lord does not merely pay them but removes the bad residue of action and restores their condition, so human repair and divine repair answer one another without becoming a simple wage exchange.

activation_trace.role: Repair opposed to corruption forms the lexical arc from their deeds to God's remaking of them.
Removal of estrangement keeps social reconciliation live within both righteous action and repaired condition.
Intentional action is the human contribution to the reciprocal repair arc.
The removal of offense residue prevents prior damage from governing the repaired state.
Gradual nurture, completion, and repair characterize the Lordly agency behind the response.
Condition, affair, and spacious well-being make the outcome a restored mode of life, not only an inward feeling.

changed_reading.before: Good deeds earn cancellation of bad deeds and a better mood.
changed_reading.after: Righteous repair offered by people is answered by Lordly repair of the people themselves: damage is covered and their whole condition is made sound.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence joins what is set down, what fits reality, the nurturing Lord, suitable action, and the repair of the inner self.
baseline_models.mechanism: A spatial-functional analogy runs through the ayah: revelation is placed in its proper station, truth fits its joint, suitable deeds answer that fit, and Lordly repair reorders the recipient's inner configuration. The proposed propagation from message-placement to self-placement is analogical rather than grammatically explicit.

activation_trace.role: Putting something in its proper station supplies the initial image of right placement.
A fitted joint or matching receptacle makes truth an exact functional fit rather than an abstraction.
Suitability to a thing lets righteous action and repaired bāl register as restored fit.
Nurturing something toward completion supplies the agency that carries fit into the recipient.
The heart and what occupies it are the receiving configuration put back into order.

changed_reading.before: A true message is received and believers are subsequently comforted.
changed_reading.after: Right placement propagates: a rightly situated message elicits fitting action and the nurturing Lord resituates the recipient's interior.

context_deltas.mechanism: The neighboring contrast turns works from stored units into directed movement. Obstruction diverts from a traversable way and work is lost; following either falsehood or truth then determines whether intentional action continues toward a stable end.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful action is the focus anchor whose direction is revised by the context.
Stable reality supplies the orientation against which a trajectory succeeds or misses.
Turning away and diverting supplies the force that bends action off course.
A traversable extended path gives works a directional medium rather than a ledger slot.
Following in another's wake supplies the continuing movement of both competing orientations.
Departure from truth and stability names the failure state opposed to the focus ayah's truth.

structural_cues: 47:1 places diversion from a path immediately before the loss of works, while 47:3 contrasts following falsehood with following truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies path, diversion, lost works, and two followings; I infer that direction is constitutive of a work's efficacy. A live alternative is that the context only contrasts groups and outcomes without redefining عمل itself.

changed_reading.before: Righteous works are a stock of discrete meritorious acts.
changed_reading.after: Righteous works are purposeful movement maintained in alignment with truth; diversion can make an apparently active trajectory miss or disappear.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence from war's burdens being laid down, through guidance and repeated repair of bāl, to recognition of a destination makes repair function as reorientation after severe burden. It restores an inhabitable direction, not merely a pleasant feeling.

activation_trace.role: The heart and field of concern are the focus anchor reoriented after burden.
The literal burdens of war supply the weight from which the following repair sequence emerges.
Gentle indication toward the path makes restoration directional.
The exact repeated repair verb confirms that the focus outcome continues into the next ayah.
Restoration of condition and affair broadens repair beyond private emotion.
Recognition by trace or sign supplies the legible destination reached by restored orientation.

structural_cues: 47:4-6 run in packet order from setting down war's burdens to guidance, repair of bāl, entry, and recognition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies that sequence; I supply the arrow from laid-down burden to repaired orientation. The pronouns may instead concern those killed, and the clauses may be successive promises rather than a recovery mechanism.

changed_reading.before: God improves the believers' mood after forgiving them.
changed_reading.after: God restores an orientation capable of carrying burdened people from dislocation toward a destination they can recognize and inhabit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The inverse sequence in 47:9 makes reception of descent a functional gate. Aversion to what descends is followed by the collapse of works; in 47:2 renewed assent to what descends is followed by covering and repair.

activation_trace.role: The doubled heart-resting assent is the positive receptive state sharpened by the inverse context.
Delivered revelation is the focus object whose reception conditions the fate of action.
Aversion opposed to acceptance supplies the inverse receptive posture.
The repeated delivered object makes the inversion lexically exact.
Falling and collapse supply the opposite outcome to covering wrongs and repairing bāl.

structural_cues: 47:9 causally links aversion to what was sent down with the collapse of works, reversing the order and outcome of 47:2.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the lexical reversal and causal connector; I infer that receptivity gates the continuing validity of action. A live alternative is that the works collapse because they were already corrupt, with aversion serving as evidence rather than mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Belief in what was sent down merely specifies the creed already named before the deeds.
changed_reading.after: The second belief is an active reception that keeps deeds from collapsing; repeated faith performs a distinct gating function.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mere auditory contact can end in a stamped heart, while accepted guidance generates additional guidance. This turns the two faith clauses in 47:2 into stages of a feedback process in which reception changes the receiver's future capacity to receive.

activation_trace.role: Repeated assent anchors an iterative rather than one-time account of faith.
Repair of the heart-like inner field becomes increased receptive capacity.
The understanding-and-compliance branch exposes the gap between sound contact and effective hearing.
A seal or fixed impression supplies the blocked terminal state of failed reception.
Guidance toward the path is both prior disposition and renewed gift in the feedback loop.
Increase and growth make successful reception cumulative.

structural_cues: 47:16 contrasts listening with a sealed heart; 47:17 immediately states that those already guided receive increased guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed hearing and cumulative guidance; I infer that repaired bāl is the receiver's enlarged capacity within that loop. The alternative is that the ayat describe fixed contrasting groups rather than stages available to one person.

changed_reading.before: The repeated faith clause restates a settled identity.
changed_reading.after: Faith is recursively renewed: reception, action, and inner repair enlarge the capacity for further guidance, while failed reception can harden that capacity shut.

context_deltas.mechanism: Requested revelation becomes a firmly decided demand, exposing disequilibrium in the heart; the answer is obedience, resolved intention, and truth made good in action. Thus صالحات are not generic moral items but enacted truth when revelation becomes costly.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful action anchors the move from professed reception to costly enactment.
Truth matching stable reality is what action must embody rather than merely name.
Firmness, exactness, and binding construction make the requested message operationally demanding.
Departure from health and balance identifies the inner failure exposed by costly content.
Binding the heart decisively to an affair supplies the transition from speech to action.
Fulfilling a promise in deed makes truthfulness an enacted correspondence.

structural_cues: 47:20 moves from asking for a surah to recoil when its demand is made firm; 47:21 answers with obedience, resolve, and truthfulness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies requested revelation, a costly command, heart-disease, resolve, and fulfilled truth; I infer that the cost diagnoses whether belief has become عمل صالح. The alternative is a battle-specific exhortation with no general account of righteous work.

changed_reading.before: Doing righteous deeds means accumulating conventionally good acts after professing belief.
changed_reading.after: Doing righteous deeds includes making received truth operational precisely when its demand tests resolve and exposes the heart.

context_deltas.mechanism: The contextual opposite of repair is a coupled breakdown: corruption spreads in the land, kinship is severed, and hearts become inaccessible to recitation. Because the focus inventory includes reconciliation, repairing bāl can include reconnecting social bonds and reopening cognition, not only calming an individual interior.

activation_trace.role: Removal of estrangement supplies the focus-side capacity for relational repair.
The heart and its concerns anchor the cognitive-affective side of the repaired relation.
Leaving soundness and equilibrium supplies the exact contextual opposite of repair.
Severed connection turns corruption into a concrete social rupture.
Kinship names the living relation that rupture destroys and reconciliation can restore.
Closure, hardness, and dryness make failed reception the cognitive form of disconnection.

structural_cues: 47:22 links turning away to social corruption and severed kinship; 47:23-24 then move through deafness and blindness to locked hearts before the Qur'an.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies social rupture followed by blocked perception; I infer that the focus repair spans both relations and reception. A live alternative is that these are parallel consequences of turning away and that bāl remains primarily private condition.

changed_reading.before: Repairing bāl is private psychological consolation.
changed_reading.after: Repairing bāl can be relational and cognitive reintegration: estrangement is reduced, bonds remain joinable, and the heart reopens to recitation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Retreat after clarity becomes a concealed bargain to obey opponents in only part of the matter, followed by the collapse of works. The focus clause about believing what was sent down therefore resists compartmentalized reception: action cannot be sealed off from selective allegiance.

activation_trace.role: Resting assent anchors the whole reception that partial compliance fractures.
Retreat from a received orientation supplies the reversal of the focus sequence.
Disclosure and clarity remove simple ignorance as the cause of retreat.
The same delivered object ties selective obedience directly back to the focus revelation clause.
Compliance supplies the allegiance being redirected toward those averse to descent.
Partition into only a part supplies the mechanism of compartmentalized reception.
Concealment in the interior makes partial allegiance compatible with an outward believing identity.
Collapse supplies the eventual fate of works divided from whole reception.

structural_cues: 47:25-28 move from retreat after clarity, through secret partial obedience to those averse to descent, to the collapse of works.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies retreat, clarity, partial obedience, secrecy, and collapsed works; I infer that believing in what descended means non-compartmentalized allegiance. The alternative is a specific political betrayal rather than a general property of reception.

changed_reading.before: Believing the revelation is assent to its truth while deeds can remain a separable moral portfolio.
changed_reading.after: Believing what descended is whole reception: selective hidden allegiance can fracture the relation between professed truth and action and thereby void the portfolio.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence treats hidden interior states as latent but not inert: they are brought out, become legible in marks and inflected speech, and are disclosed under testing. Repair of bāl is therefore a change expected to become diagnostically visible in conduct and endurance.

activation_trace.role: The inner self and what moves within it anchor the latent state that repair changes.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the transition from latency to evidence.
A visible sign from which condition is inferred makes the interior externally legible.
The slant of speech toward its implication provides a second diagnostic surface.
Testing that makes a condition appear supplies the disclosure process.
Knowledge of a report and an affair's interior joins observable report to hidden state.

structural_cues: 47:29 names concealed rancor with branchless ض غ ن only as a structural cue; 47:30-31 then move from marks and tone to testing reports.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, emergence, signs, speech-tone, testing, and reports; I infer that repaired bāl should alter this evidence chain. The alternative is that testing only classifies people and does not describe how inner repair works.

changed_reading.before: Repair of bāl is an inward benefit that need not have an observable trace.
changed_reading.after: Repair of bāl is transformation of a latent interior whose new condition should become legible in speech, action, and endurance under trial.

context_deltas.mechanism: A competing account-like reading remains live beside the trajectory model. The focus removes negative residue; later, God promises not to dock works and promises their wage. The person's restored condition is the surplus beyond a merely balanced account.

activation_trace.role: The wage of work makes the positive side of an account available within the focus root.
Covering offenses supplies removal of the account's negative residue.
A deprivation that subtracts a right or work supplies the denied debit against believers' works.
Compensation for work supplies the protected positive credit.
Restored condition marks an outcome richer than settling debits and credits alone.

structural_cues: 47:35 denies any subtraction from believers' works, and 47:36 promises wages for faith and protective action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covering, non-subtraction, and compensation vocabulary; I impose the debit-credit symmetry. The live alternative is that these phrases independently assure reward and should not be unified as bookkeeping.

changed_reading.before: Covering wrongs is an isolated pardon followed by comfort.
changed_reading.after: The ayah can also be read as an asymmetric settlement: liabilities are covered, earned work is protected from subtraction, and restored condition exceeds the ledger.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the concealed-nakedness branch of س و ء rather than the ordinary moral branch. It remains anchored in the focus sequence of wrongs, covering, and inner repair; downstream prose should present it only as an affective-material analogy for ending shame's exposure, not as a restriction of سيئات to sexual or bodily wrongs.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sequence كفّر عنهم سيئاتهم وأصلح بالهم permits covering to alter how shame-producing wrongs occupy the inner self.

activation_trace.role: A private exposure that is normally concealed supplies the shame-bearing edge of the wrongs.
Literal covering supplies protective containment rather than mere numerical cancellation.
The self, heart, and field of concern are released from continued organization by exposed shame.

changed_reading.before: Wrong acts are erased from an external account.
changed_reading.after: Covering can also protect the self from remaining psychically exposed to its wrongs, allowing shame to stop organizing bāl.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it connects the bodily swelling branch of ح ب ط with eating and purification imagery. It remains anchored in the focus words for intentional action, repair, and condition, plus the contextual collapse of works; downstream prose should call it a metabolic analogy for action becoming internally unsound, never a physiological claim or a complete interpretation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عملوا الصالحات and أصلح بالهم permit a contrast between action that integrates into a sound condition and action that swells, collapses, or requires purification.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful action is the material whose internal consequence the analogy tests.
Restoration opposed to corruption supplies the return to systemic soundness.
Bodily swelling from harmful consumption gives collapsed works an internally distending material image.
Eating supplies the contextual intake process that makes the metabolic analogy coherent.
Purity free of admixture supplies the contrasting image of integrated, uncorrupted nourishment.

changed_reading.before: Works either count or are abstractly nullified.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, works can integrate into a sound life or become internally distending and collapse when reception is corrupt; repair restores wholeness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a branch under خ ل د at 47:15 explicitly evokes a bāl settled in the heart even though the surface occurrence concerns abiding. It remains directly anchored to بَالهم and to the contextual contrast of abiding destinations; downstream prose should qualify it as an analogy of re-homing and stability, not equate the two roots or claim that 47:2 itself names the final abode.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repaired bāl at 47:2 word 18 can be heard as an inner condition given stable lodging rather than merely a transient calm.

activation_trace.role: The self and heart supply the focus interior capable of becoming settled.
A sound, spacious condition supplies the quality of the new inner lodging.
A bāl settled in the heart contributes the unexpected bridge from abiding to inner stabilization.

changed_reading.before: Repair of bāl is temporary relief or improved mood.
changed_reading.after: Repair can be imagined as re-homing the inner self into a stable condition that can abide rather than oscillate with every pressure.

strongest_changes: The doubled ء م ن became an iterative reception loop rather than a redundant creed formula.
عمل صالح became directed and costly enactment whose efficacy can be lost through diversion, aversion, or partial allegiance.
إصلاح البال expanded from private comfort into post-burden reorientation, relational reconnection, and a latent interior made legible under testing.
A competing account model remains live: wrongs are covered, works are not docked, and restored condition exceeds settlement.
summary.what_was_special: The trace is driven by reversals and recurrences: belief appears twice in the focus, repair recurs in 47:5, accepted descent is mirrored by hated descent and collapsed works, and later contexts expose repair through paths, resolve, relations, speech, trials, and protected work. Branch-distant shame, metabolic, and abiding images were retained with explicit containment rather than flattened into the strongest models.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether bāl here primarily names heart and concern, whole condition, or a deliberately broad overlap of both.
Whether the guidance-repair-recognition sequence in 47:4-6 describes recovery from burden or only successive promises to those killed.
Whether receptivity causally preserves works or merely reveals which works were already sound.
How far the relational and diagnostic contexts define إصلاح البال rather than supplying downstream consequences of it.
Whether the trajectory and account models should remain coexisting mechanisms or be ranked differently in synthesis.
